video_title: Lakers Media Day Interviews with Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves & Walker Kessler | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic expresses excitement about the new Lakers roster
quotes.excerpt: I'm really excited about this team. I think we have a lot of underrated guys.
quotes.quote: I'm really excited about this team. I think we have a lot of underrated guys. There are some guys that came in that are not talked about a lot, but I really enjoy them and I really like what I see.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic on the value of adding Walker Kessler
quotes.excerpt: I play a lot of games against him. He's a great rim protector.
quotes.quote: I play a lot of games against him. It's very tough to play against him. Obviously we know he's a great rim protector, but what I saw this year, how he improved his game offensively, how he can pick and pop also, and then obviously the pick and roll with me and him, I think that will be amazing, so I really wanted him.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic sets championship expectations for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I would say championship. I think we got to look at that.
quotes.quote: I would say championship. I think we got to look at that. I feel like I say this stuff a lot, but if you don't think we can win a championship, then you shouldn't be here. So, honestly, I think we have a great group, we just got to show up every day and give everything we got.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on the departure of longtime Lakers teammates
quotes.excerpt: You never want to see guys that you've been with for multiple years leave.
quotes.quote: You never want to see guys that you've been with for multiple years leave or be on a different team. You got LeBron James, Rui Hachimura, Jackson Hayes, you go down the list of guys that I've been with for multiple years that have real relationships with, on and off the court, but that's kind of how the business works.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves discusses the expectations of being a max player
quotes.excerpt: It's what comes with it, but at the same time, if I go out there and win.
quotes.quote: It's what comes with it, but at the same time, if I go out there and take care of my business and play the way that I know I can play, nothing really is to be talked about. And along those lines is winning. If you go out and win, it cures everything.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on his close relationship with Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Just not even on court, all off court stuff, I enjoy being around him.
quotes.quote: Just not even on court, all off court stuff, I enjoy being around him. Enjoy bowling at his house, playing some golf together, which he did beat me a couple days ago, which was a little crazy. He's someone that I'll be friends with for as long as I live. I respect what he's just done for basketball, how he carries himself, and on court, he makes my life easy.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on his reaction to joining the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know what to expect, honestly. I'm a believer in whatever happens is meant to happen.
quotes.quote: I didn't know what to expect, honestly. I'm a believer in whatever happens is meant to happen, and so I didn't really know. And so to be here now, I'm just so grateful and excited.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the impact of Luka Doncic's belief
quotes.excerpt: Having one of the best point guards to play, voicing that belief in you.
quotes.quote: Having one of the best point guards to play, voicing that belief in you, it makes you want to run through a brick wall for the guys. So, I'm just so excited and looking forward to this year.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler compares the current Lakers to the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: I think for one, Dallas had very good bigs, really above the rim with a lob threat.
quotes.quote: I think for one, Dallas had very good bigs, really above the rim with a lob threat. I think they had shooters all around them. I think it's a little similar to the that Dallas team, so it'll be good.
